dogecoin.text:
In 2023 you bought gold. In 2025 you buy memes.

Because let’s be real — no one 10x’ed on ETFs.
But $DOGE? $PEPE? $WIF?
Yeah. That’s where the stories come from.

Memecoins aren’t stupid.
They’re just faster at finding exit liquidity 😎
And sometimes… they hit like lottery

They laughed at memecoins.

Then $DOGE hit $80B.
Then $PEPE minted millionaires.
Then Solana turned into a meme casino.
And now… it’s happening again.

It’s not just memes.
It’s liquidity.
It’s culture.
It’s crypto’s attention economy.

Bet wisely. Exit smarter.
But don’t fade
